title: İTÜ Lecture (A1): Marine Robotics & Naval Architecture
subtitle: İTÜ Proficiency • While-Listening Akademik Ders
instructions_tr: İstanbul Teknik Üniversitesi (İTÜ Proficiency) formatına özel A1 seviyesi While-Listening (Dinlerken Çözme) sınavıdır. Konu: deniz robotiği ve gemi inşaatı mühendisliği ve laboratuvar güvenlik protokolleri ve ekipman kalibrasyonu.
audio_script: Welcome to the İstanbul Teknik Üniversitesi (İTÜ) Academic Listening Seminar at Maslak Kampüsü. In today's A1-level lecture, we will analyze Marine Robotics & Naval Architecture with a specific focus on laboratory safety protocols and equipment calibration. First, let us examine why İTÜ researchers initiated the 2019 longitudinal project. Conventional methodologies in marine robotics & naval architecture often struggled with environmental fluctuations and calibration drift. To address this limitation, our faculty monitored 150 independent test groups over two academic semesters. Second, the empirical findings revealed two critical outcomes. When teams applied automated verification protocols during laboratory safety protocols and equipment calibration, diagnostic accuracy increased by thirty-eight percent, while operational delays decreased by nearly half. Conversely, units that relied on manual uncalibrated logs experienced significant data bottlenecks. Finally, what is the implication for future İTÜ students? Mastering interdisciplinary data literacy and ethical compliance is indispensable for both the İTÜ Proficiency examination and your upcoming faculty coursework.
suggested_notes_tr: Kurum & Sınav: İstanbul Teknik Üniversitesi (İTÜ Proficiency - A1)
1. Araştırma Konusu: deniz robotiği ve gemi inşaatı mühendisliği (laboratuvar güvenlik protokolleri ve ekipman kalibrasyonu) — 2019 yılı, 150 test grubu.
2. Bulgular: Otomatik doğrulama ile %38 doğruluk artışı ve gecikmelerde %50 azalma.
3. Sonuç: Disiplinlerarası veri okuryazarlığı ve etik uyum şarttır.

To reduce the number of students taking the İTÜ Proficiency examination.
To eliminate automated verification from marine robotics & naval architecture laboratories.

instructions_tr: TOBB Ekonomi ve Teknoloji Üniversitesi (TOBB ETÜ İYS) formatına özel C2 seviyesi Note-Taking (Not Alma) sınavıdır. Konu: ortak eğitim endüstri mühendisliği ve ihracat analitiği ve lisansüstü tez danışmanlığı ve deneysel tekrarlanabilirlik.
audio_script: Welcome to the TOBB Ekonomi ve Teknoloji Üniversitesi (TOBB ETÜ) Academic Listening Seminar at Söğütözü Kampüsü. In today's C2-level lecture, we will analyze Cooperative Industrial Engineering & Export Analytics with a specific focus on graduate thesis supervision and experimental replication. First, let us examine why TOBB ETÜ researchers initiated the 2021 longitudinal project. Conventional methodologies in cooperative industrial engineering & export analytics often struggled with environmental fluctuations and calibration drift. To address this limitation, our faculty monitored 425 independent test groups over two academic semesters. Second, the empirical findings revealed two critical outcomes. When teams applied automated verification protocols during graduate thesis supervision and experimental replication, diagnostic accuracy increased by thirty-eight percent, while operational delays decreased by nearly half. Conversely, units that relied on manual uncalibrated logs experienced significant data bottlenecks. Finally, what is the implication for future TOBB ETÜ students? Mastering interdisciplinary data literacy and ethical compliance is indispensable for both the TOBB ETÜ İYS examination and your upcoming faculty coursework.
suggested_notes_tr: Kurum & Sınav: TOBB Ekonomi ve Teknoloji Üniversitesi (TOBB ETÜ İYS - C2)
1. Araştırma Konusu: ortak eğitim endüstri mühendisliği ve ihracat analitiği (lisansüstü tez danışmanlığı ve deneysel tekrarlanabilirlik) — 2021 yılı, 425 test grubu.
2. Bulgular: Otomatik doğrulama ile %38 doğruluk artışı ve gecikmelerde %50 azalma.
3. Sonuç: Disiplinlerarası veri okuryazarlığı ve etik uyum şarttır.

title: Urban Bees and Rooftop Beekeeping
subtitle: Kentsel Ekoloji ve Çatı Arıcılığı
instructions_tr: Şehirlerde arıcılık ve biyoçeşitlilik dersini dinleyin.
audio_script: In major global metropolises from London to Istanbul, rooftop beekeeping has evolved into a popular ecological movement. Honeybees play a vital pollination role for urban community gardens, parks, and fruit trees. Surprisingly, research demonstrates that urban bees often produce more diverse and pesticide-free honey than rural agricultural bees. This is because modern cities feature diverse decorative flowers blooming continuously across private balconies and public parks, whereas intensive rural farmland frequently relies on monoculture crops sprayed with agricultural insecticides. Urban beehives help maintain city biodiversity while raising ecological awareness.

Neden: Şehir parklarında sürekli açan çiçek çeşitliliği var; kırsalda tek tip ürün ve kimyasal ilaçlama yaygın

title: The Engineering of Suspension Bridges
subtitle: Asma Köprülerin Mühendislik Prensipleri
instructions_tr: Asma köprülerin yük taşıma sistemini dinleyip soruları cevaplayınız.
audio_script: Suspension bridges are magnificent feats of civil engineering capable of spanning vast waterways. The architectural principle relies on balancing tension and compression. The roadway deck is hung suspended from vertical suspender cables, which are in turn connected to two massive main cables draped over soaring concrete towers. The immense weight of vehicles transfers upward into tension along the cables, and then downward into compression through the towers into bedrock foundations. The 1915 Çanakkale Bridge in Turkey currently holds the world record for the longest main suspension span, measuring 2,023 meters.

Yapı: Tabliye dikey kablolarla ana kablolara, ana kablolar kulelere bağlı
Yük aktarımı: Araç ağırlığı kablolarda çekmeye, kulelerde ise zemine basınç kuvvetine dönüşür
Rekor: 1915 Çanakkale Köprüsü (2.023 metre ana açıklık ile dünya rekoru)

title: Structural Semiotics and Derrida's Différance
subtitle: Genel C2 İleri Felsefe ve Dilbilim
instructions_tr: Jacques Derrida'nın yapısöküm (deconstruction) ve différance kavramını dinleyip soruları yanıtlayın.
audio_script: In twentieth-century continental philosophy, Jacques Derrida's deconstructive intervention radicalized Saussurean structural linguistics by interrogating the Western metaphysical tradition of the 'metaphysics of presence'. Ferdinand de Saussure had demonstrated that language is a system of differential signs without positive terms: a signifier signifies only by virtue of what it is not within a relational network. Derrida observed that Western philosophy had persistently repressed this differential nature by seeking an ultimate 'transcendental signified'—an unmediated, self-present origin such as God, Reason, or Sensory Immediacy. To deconstruct this illusion, Derrida coined the neologism 'différance', combining the dual French meanings of differing and deferring. Meaning, Derrida asserts, is never fully present in a discrete linguistic sign; it is spatially differentiated from other signifiers and temporally deferred across an infinite chain of sign substitution. Because meaning is perpetually postponed, all texts contain unresolvable internal contradictions, or aporias, that systematically undo their own totalizing claims.
suggested_notes_tr: Jacques Derrida ve Yapısöküm (Deconstruction)
Varlık Metafiziği (Metaphysics of Presence): Batı felsefesinin nihai bir 'Aşkın Gösterilen' (Tanrı, Akıl, Özne) arayışının eleştirisi
Différance kavramı: Fransızca 'differ' (farklılaşmak) ve 'defer' (ertelemek) kelimelerinin birleşimi
Anlamın yapısı: Anlam hiçbir zaman tek bir kelimede tam olarak 'mevcut' değildir; uzamsal olarak farklılaşır ve zamansal olarak sonsuz zincirde ertelenir
Aporia (Çıkmaz): Tüm metinler kendi iddialarını bozan içsel çözülemez çelişkiler barındırır
